title: Northbeam TechWorks Cash Office Note: Money Already Held on a Job
content:
Whether money already received on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is treated as held against the charges a desk settlement covers turns on whether a part was ordered for the job and on the day the payment was recorded.

**Where a part was ordered for the job and a payment stands recorded on it for the day the job was held for parts**, that payment is treated as the deposit taken on the part and taken off the charges being covered.

**Where no part was ordered for the job and a payment stands recorded on it**, the payments already received are taken off the charges being covered.

**Where neither of those situations holds**, no payment at all is taken off the charges being covered.

## The three readings

| A part was ordered for the job | Payments recorded on the job | Taken off the charges being covered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | one for the day the job was held for parts | that payment, as the deposit taken on the part |
| yes | none for that day | nothing |
| no | at least one | the payments already received |
| no | none | nothing |

Where a part was ordered, only a payment recorded for the day the job was held for parts counts as money already held; a payment recorded on some other day of such a job is not taken off under this reading.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No part ordered, two payments.** A hypothetical job for which no part was ordered carries payments of 96.00 USD and 208.50 USD. The second reading governs and 304.50 USD is taken off the charges being covered.

**A part ordered, the payment on another day.** A hypothetical job was held for parts on one day and a part was ordered for it, but its only payment, of 118.40 USD, is recorded for the day the crew was dispatched. That falls outside the first reading and outside the second, so nothing is taken off.

**A part ordered, a payment on the hold day.** The same job with the 118.40 USD payment recorded for the day it was held for parts instead. The first reading governs and 118.40 USD is taken off the charges being covered.
